art_direction: 修长清晰的眼型与略平短眉，钴蓝天青虹膜，冷灰白底。
composition: optically centered five-feature face, two comparable eyes, two brows, a short mouth; ample negative space
creative_direction: Design the crispest, most composed face in the collection. The two eyes are long and slender but comfortably open, shaped by a nearly horizontal central upper lid that transitions into a clean, gently ascending outer taper. Round the inner corners just enough to avoid an aggressive angular mask. Weight the black paint toward the upper outer lids, while keeping the lower edges thin and controlled. Both pupils look straight ahead and occupy much of the opening; they should never shrink to small watchful dots. Cobalt blue appears as concentrated side crescents, fading into a touch of airy cyan near their lower ends. Broad ivory highlights soften the otherwise decisive black forms. Use two compact, nearly level gray eyebrows with slightly softened ends. The mouth is a fine, level dash placed close enough to keep the face visually connected. The cool gray-white ground supports a restrained, handsome presence. Preserve brush character at the edges without adding scratches, splatters, lashes, or decorative symbols.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed contact sheet inspected for appealing coordinated eye shapes and gaze, large dark pupils and ivory highlights, centered composition, quiet pale background, restrained matte palette, no head or extra features, no text or watermark
